purpose: Engineering comparison only; not statistical confirmation, AC security, completed interconnection study, market validation or commercial superiority.
cohort: Public PGLib IEEE14 development; IEEE30 fresh successor selected before outcome inspection, plus verifier-controlled small connected DC networks and bridge/topology/parameter-change counterexamples.

electrical_contract.model: Lossless linear DC with all active branch reactances, off-nominal taps, phase shifts, baseMVA, injections, status and thermal ratings represented. One declared slack balances mismatch; disconnected components are never silently balanced.
electrical_contract.branch_outage: Set selected branch inactive; its flow is exactly zero.
electrical_contract.thermal: rateA <= 0 is unbounded; otherwise abs(flow) > rateA plus tolerance is a violation.

endpoints: Every connected contingency agrees with independent direct linear solve, atol 1e-6 MW and rtol 1e-8.
Any islanding outage is marked UNKNOWN/ISLANDING and never accepted as a normal connected solution.
Disconnected imbalance is UNKNOWN; no invented per-island slack supply.
Outage branch flow is zero within tolerance.
Changes in endpoints, branch order, bus ordering, reactance, tap, phase, active status, injections, baseMVA or thermal ratings cannot reuse stale complete-result cache.
Reject malformed, nonfinite, duplicate-ID, invalid-reference, zero-reactance and oversized input before computation.
Frozen candidate identity and input hash must match at verification; mismatches fail closed.
Evidence output is exclusive; repeat and interrupted recovery cannot overwrite existing evidence.
comparison: Root builder candidate versus verifier-authored direct per-outage linear solver. Conventional LODF with identical safeguards is a strong ordinary-reuse alternative; timing against repeated direct solve cannot establish novelty or superiority to that alternative.
decision_rule: Any connected flow mismatch or unsafe island acceptance FAILS engineering qualification. All endpoints passing permits only DC engineering qualification in the executed scope. No commercial or learning claim follows.

confirmation_error_budget.reason: Deterministic engineering counterexamples and benchmark replication only; no inferential confirmation attempted.

separation: Verifier agent does not modify candidate. Panel is generated and held by verifier until candidate source freeze. Shared model family, tools, host, filesystem and libraries mean procedural role separation, not external independent certification or OS-enforced secrecy.
counterexample_plan: Bridge outage causing denominator singularity; tap/phase/rating changes challenging stale cache and simplified electrical models. Exact cases withheld from builder until evaluation.
